findings.statement: The host creates one dinner question with a fixed set of 2–8 place options before voting starts.
Members vote on the same device under a self-chosen code (pseudonym), one option per person; re-submitting with the same code replaces the earlier choice so a person still holds exactly one vote.
A per-option tally is the visible deliverable: two people on different options must show total 2 with 1/1, and after one changes vote still total 2 (0/2).
The host can close the poll; after closing, further votes return poll_closed and the stored result is unchanged. The host can reopen, after which a third member can vote for a total of 3.
A vote option must belong to the poll being voted on; duplicate options and an empty code must be rejected, and votes from different polls must never be merged.
Poll state and aggregate must survive a page refresh and a process restart in the same directory, and a tie must be displayed as a tie rather than resolved by an arbitrary winner.
The upstream product is a Nextcloud server application written in PHP and JS/Vue, positioned as a free meeting-schedule tool similar to Doodle, not a standalone same-device poll page.

The poll entity has exactly two declared poll types, datePoll and textPoll, plus a 'simple' voting variant; the model is oriented to date/text option scheduling rather than a generic single-choice question.
A vote is stored per option as an answer of yes, no, or maybe, not as a single selected option; the poll carries allowMaybe and useNo settings that govern those answer modes.

Votes are soft-deleted rows carrying pollId, userId, option id, a snapshot of the option text, an option hash, and the answer, so a vote row is bound to a poll and an option record rather than to a free-text answer.

Option identity in the vote is cryptographically derived from the poll id plus the option text, and a separate accessor exposes the raw stored hash so mismatches between text and hash can be detected.

Poll lifecycle is driven by an integer expiry timestamp: a poll is expired when expire > 0 and expire < now, and voting is denied whenever the poll is expired. No explicit open/closed boolean or reopen field appears in the supplied Poll entity.
Archival is separate from closing: a deleted timestamp marks the poll archived, and the entity distinguishes isArchived from isExpired in its status payload.
Result visibility is a three-way poll setting (always, closed, never); editors always see results, participants see them only per the setting, and the legacy value 'expired' is mapped to 'closed'.

Participation identity is a Nextcloud user identity: the poll stores an owner user id, each vote stores a userId, and voting is restricted to external, user, or admin user types (other external types must register first).
Anonymity is a poll setting with a lockable state: a negative anonymous value means real anonymous and is treated as locked so the setting cannot be changed back.

Access and roles are granular: access is private or open, roles include owner/admin/user/email/contact/external/none, and there are more than twenty named permissions covering edit, vote, see results, see usernames, add options, comment, share, download, deanonymize, and change foreign votes.
Changing another participant's votes and deanonymizing are separately gated privileges tied to edit rights, an unrestricted poll owner, and an unlocked anonymity setting.
Option creation by participants is a configurable proposal mode (disallow, allow, review) with an optional proposal expiry, and public shares are explicitly barred from adding options.
Vote volume controls exist as maxVotesPerUser and maxVotesPerOption, i.e. limits on votes, not a limit on the number of poll options.
Cloning a poll produces a private, deanonymized copy titled 'Clone of …' with settings carried over and no votes; deletion/archive supports an auto-delete offset in days.

Documented product-level capabilities include hiding results, obfuscating participant names, automatic expiry, participant-added options, per-option/per-user vote limits, invitations, export to spreadsheet/HTML, reminders, comments, confirming options after closing, notifications, calendar conflict hints, and a REST API.

The README states the app is not maintained by Nextcloud despite living in the Nextcloud GitHub organisation, and its screenshots describe managing/creating polls, many configuration options, sharing a poll, and voting on mobile.

Licensing is GNU AGPL version 3 (COPYING text) with SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later headers in the supplied PHP files; the snapshot records license status as fixed_notice_located_spdx_not_independently_verified.
Upstream was not executed: the snapshot records upstream_status = not_run, so every upstream statement here is a static reading of the pinned files, not an observed behavior.

findings.rationale: Upstream couples stoppage to expire and has no reopen field in the supplied entity; the scenario requires manual close and explicit reopen.
findings.statement: Model closing/reopening as an explicit poll status transition owned by the host, instead of reusing an expiry timestamp as the only way to stop voting; store close and reopen events so a closed poll rejects writes with poll_closed and a reopened poll accepts new voters.

findings.rationale: Upstream's per-option yes/no/maybe rows with user ids do not satisfy one-person-one-choice on a shared device.
findings.statement: Represent a ballot as (poll id, pseudonym code, single option id) with uniqueness on (poll id, code); a re-vote by the same code replaces that ballot rather than appending a second one, and the aggregate is recomputed from ballots.

findings.rationale: Binds the scenario's option-membership and duplicate/empty rejection rules to identity rather than free text.
findings.statement: Give options stable poll-scoped ids and validate that a submitted option id belongs to the submitted poll; normalize labels and reject duplicates and empty option labels at creation.

findings.rationale: Scenario requires same-directory process restart persistence; no server database or account layer is in scope.
findings.statement: Use a single durable local store in the application directory with atomic writes, and derive totals from stored ballots on load so refresh and restart reproduce identical state.

findings.rationale: Explicit acceptance rule; differs from any winner-oriented framing.
findings.statement: Display ties as equal counts with all tied options listed and no winner designation, and never synthesize a tiebreaker.

findings.rationale: product_shape_guidance calls for pseudonyms and host/member actions with no remote authentication platform.
findings.statement: Separate host surface (create poll, set options, close, reopen, view tally) from participant surface (enter code, select one option, submit, see current tally), both usable sequentially on one device without per-member accounts.

findings.rationale: Keeps the product inside the leaf's defining core and out of scheduling/survey territory.
findings.statement: Borrow upstream's configurability ideas only where they map to this scenario (result visibility during/after voting, one-vote-per-person enforcement); do not import Nextcloud accounts, shares, groups, REST API, reminders, comments, or calendar integration.
How the upstream aggregate is computed and displayed (counts, percentages, chart, tie presentation) cannot be determined: no tally, mapper, controller, or frontend file is in the supplied inventory.
Upstream reopen-after-close behavior is unknown; the supplied entity exposes only expire and deleted, and no reopen action was read.

Whether upstream supports same-device sequential voting under self-declared pseudonyms without accounts is unknown and is contradicted by the user-type gate on voting; no such path appears in the supplied files.
Upstream rejection of duplicate option labels, empty option labels, or empty participant identifiers is not evidenced in the supplied files.
No upstream rule limiting a poll to 2–8 options was found; the discovered limits apply to votes per user and votes per option.
Runtime behavior, persistence across restarts, and any error code such as poll_closed were not executed or observed upstream (upstream_status not_run).

The supplied upstream inventory is four files only (COPYING, README.md, lib/Db/Poll.php, lib/Db/Vote.php); entity definitions are visible but routing, controllers, services, mappers, migrations, and frontend are absent.

gaps.statement: Upstream status is not_run and no execution was permitted: all upstream findings are static readings of four pinned files, so no observed runtime behavior exists for either product.

No aggregation/tally implementation was supplied (no mapper, service, controller, or frontend), so the upstream per-option counts, percentages, chart behavior, and total-participant display remain unknown.
Upstream close and reopen semantics cannot be established from Poll.php and Vote.php: stopping votes depends on the expire timestamp, and no reopen operation or explicit closed flag was read.

No upstream evidence supports same-device sequential pseudonymous voting; the voting gate requires an external, user, or admin identity. Whether any accountless public-share path exists is outside the supplied files.
Upstream validation for duplicate option labels, empty option text, empty voter identifiers, and option-to-poll membership at write time is not present in the supplied entity files.
No upstream 2–8 option-count constraint was found; only vote limits per user and per option are evidenced. The scenario's option ceiling is a product requirement, not an upstream observation.
Tie handling upstream is unknown; no comparison or ranking logic was supplied, and the results view is not present.
Effect of editing option text after votes exist is unknown: the vote stores both option text and a text-derived hash, and a raw-hash accessor exists, but the reconciling code was not supplied.
Durability across refresh or process restart was neither tested nor evidenced for either product; persistence behavior for the scenario remains a design requirement rather than an observation.

License status is fixed_notice_located_spdx_not_independently_verified; COPYING matches AGPL-3.0 text and file headers declare AGPL-3.0-or-later, but no independent SPDX verification or runtime packaging check was performed.

value.given: A poll holds two ballots and the host has moved it to closed status, while the shared device still shows the member voting surface.
value.negative: Neither a first ballot under a new code nor a replacement under an existing code may be stored while the poll is closed, and the aggregate must not shift by even one count.
value.then: Both writes are rejected with response poll_closed, no ballot row is added or changed, and the tally still reports the two original ballots with unchanged per-option counts.
value.when: A member submits a first ballot under a new code, and a different member re-submits with an existing code to change their choice.

value.given: An existing poll is open on the shared device and a member is at the start view.
value.negative: A poll created by a member, without any host declaration, would hand setup ownership to the wrong role and break the fixed option-set guarantee.
value.then: The attempt is refused as not_host, the setup form is not offered to the member, no poll or option row is stored, and the existing poll stays unchanged.
value.when: The member attempts to create a second poll through the host-only setup entry.

value.given: An open poll has one ballot for code ana on option A and the tally has just been displayed.
value.negative: If ballots lived only in memory, or if startup replayed a stored write, the count would drop to zero or double instead of staying at one.
value.then: The ballot is re-read with the same code and option, the per-option counts and total are identical, and no ballot is duplicated or replayed.
value.when: The surface is refreshed and the process is stopped and started again in the same application directory.

basis.statement: The host creates one dinner question with a fixed set of 2-8 place options before voting starts.
Members vote on the same device under a self-chosen code, one option per person, and re-submitting with the same code replaces the earlier choice so the person still holds exactly one vote.
A per-option tally is the visible deliverable, with a total that stays at 2 when two members choose different options and 2 again after one changes vote.
The host can close the poll, after which further votes return poll_closed and the stored result is unchanged, and can reopen it so a third member can vote for a total of 3.
A vote option must belong to the poll being voted on, duplicate and empty option labels and empty codes must be rejected, and votes from different polls must never merge.
Poll state and aggregate survive a page refresh and a process restart in the same directory, and a tie is displayed as a tie rather than resolved by an arbitrary winner.
The upstream product is a Nextcloud server application in PHP and JS/Vue, positioned as a free meeting-schedule tool similar to Doodle rather than a standalone same-device poll page.
The poll entity declares only datePoll and textPoll types plus a simple voting variant, oriented to date or text option scheduling rather than a generic single-choice question.
A vote is stored per option as yes, no, or maybe, and the poll carries allowMaybe, useNo, and result-visibility settings that govern those answer modes.

Vote rows are soft-deleted records carrying poll id, user id, option id, an option text snapshot, an option hash, and an answer, so a vote is bound to a poll and an option record rather than to free text.
Option identity in the vote is cryptographically derived from the poll id plus the option text, and a separate accessor exposes the stored hash so text and hash mismatches can be detected.

Poll lifecycle is driven by an integer expiry timestamp: a poll is expired when expire is greater than zero and less than now, and voting is denied while expired; no explicit open or closed boolean or reopen field appears.
Archival is separate from closing: a deleted timestamp marks the poll archived, and the status payload distinguishes archived from expired.
Result visibility is a three-way setting of always, closed, or never; editors always see results, participants see them per the setting, and the legacy value expired is mapped to closed.
Participation identity is a Nextcloud user identity: polls store an owner id, votes store a user id, and voting is restricted to external, user, or admin user types.
Anonymity is a poll setting with a lockable state: a negative anonymous value means real anonymous and cannot be changed back.

Access is private or open, roles include owner, admin, user, email, contact, external, and none, and more than twenty named permissions cover edit, vote, results, usernames, options, comments, sharing, download, deanonymization, and changing foreign votes.
Changing another participant's votes and deanonymizing are separately gated privileges tied to edit rights, an unrestricted poll owner, and an unlocked anonymity setting.
Participant option creation is a proposal mode of disallow, allow, or review with an optional proposal expiry, and public shares are barred from adding options.
Vote volume controls exist as maxVotesPerUser and maxVotesPerOption, limits on votes rather than on the number of poll options.
Cloning produces a private, deanonymized copy titled Clone of ... with settings carried over and no votes, and deletion supports an auto-delete offset in days.

Documented capabilities include hiding results, obfuscating names, automatic expiry, participant-added options, per-option and per-user vote limits, invitations, spreadsheet or HTML export, reminders, comments, confirming options after closing, notifications, calendar conflict hints, and a REST API.

The README states the app is not maintained by Nextcloud despite living in the Nextcloud GitHub organisation, and its screenshots describe managing and creating polls, many configuration options, sharing a poll, and voting on mobile.
Licensing is GNU AGPL version 3 in COPYING with AGPL-3.0-or-later SPDX headers in the PHP files, recorded as fixed_notice_located_spdx_not_independently_verified.
Upstream was not executed: the snapshot records upstream_status not_run, so all upstream statements are static readings of four pinned files rather than observed behavior.
The supplied upstream inventory is only COPYING, README.md, lib/Db/Poll.php, and lib/Db/Vote.php; routing, controllers, services, mappers, migrations, and frontend are absent.

Model closing and reopening as explicit host-owned poll status transitions with recorded events, instead of reusing an expiry timestamp as the only way to stop voting, so a closed poll rejects writes with poll_closed and a reopened poll accepts new voters.
Represent a ballot as poll id plus pseudonym code plus one option id with uniqueness on poll id and code, so re-voting replaces the ballot and the aggregate is recomputed from ballots.
Give options stable poll-scoped ids, validate that a ballot's option belongs to the same poll, and reject duplicate or empty option labels at creation.
Use one durable local store in the application directory with atomic writes and derive totals from stored ballots on load, so refresh and same-directory restart reproduce identical state.
Display ties as equal counts with every tied option listed, no winner designation, and no synthesized tiebreaker.
Separate a host setup and control surface from a member voting and result surface, both usable sequentially on one device without per-member accounts.

Borrow upstream configurability only where it maps to this scenario, such as result visibility and one-vote-per-person enforcement, and leave out accounts, shares, groups, REST API, reminders, comments, calendar integration, anonymity machinery, and option proposals.

How the upstream aggregate is computed and displayed, including counts, percentages, charts, total participants, and tie presentation, cannot be determined because no tally, mapper, controller, or frontend file is in the supplied inventory.
Upstream reopen-after-close behavior is unknown; the supplied entity exposes only expire and deleted, and no reopen action was read.
Whether upstream supports same-device sequential voting under self-declared pseudonyms without accounts is unknown and is contradicted by the user-type gate on voting.
Upstream rejection of duplicate option labels, empty option labels, or empty participant identifiers is not evidenced in the supplied files.
No upstream rule limiting a poll to 2-8 options was found; the discovered limits apply to votes per user and votes per option.
Runtime behavior, persistence across restarts, and any error code such as poll_closed were neither executed nor observed upstream because upstream_status is not_run.

rules.statement: A poll carries exactly one question and between 2 and 8 predefined options; a creation with fewer than 2 or more than 8 options fails and stores nothing.
Each option has a stable id scoped to its poll; labels are trimmed and case-folded for duplicate detection, and blank or duplicate labels are rejected before anything is stored.
A ballot is uniquely identified by poll id plus voter code; the code must be nonblank, and submitting again with the same code replaces that ballot instead of adding a second one.
A ballot's option must belong to the same poll as the ballot; an unknown option or an option from another poll is rejected and never recorded.
All reads and writes are scoped by poll id, so options, ballots, and counts from different polls never mix and a foreign option cannot enter another poll's aggregate.
While a poll is closed, every ballot write, new or changed, is rejected with response poll_closed and the stored ballots and aggregate remain unchanged.
Reopening sets the poll back to open, appends a reopened event, keeps every existing ballot, and admits new codes and replacements under the same open-poll rules.

The aggregate is recomputed from stored ballots on every read: one count per option including zeros, a total equal to the number of distinct codes, and all options sharing the highest count reported as tied with no winner field.

Poll state, options, ballots, and lifecycle events live in one local store inside the application directory, written atomically and reloaded at start, so refresh and same-directory process restart reproduce the same status and aggregate.
Only the host may create a poll, close it, and reopen it; members may only cast or change their own ballot under their code and read the aggregate.
A member's code is used only to locate their own ballot; the aggregate surfaces no code-to-choice mapping, so no member can read another member's individual choice.

scope_options.rationale: The scenario requires a manual freeze and a later reopen with preserved ballots, which the upstream expiry timestamp cannot express; this slice adds the two host transitions and their events.

scope_options.name: Durable local store across restart
scope_options.rationale: Acceptance requires identical state after refresh and a same-directory process restart; this slice supplies one atomic file-backed store and load-time recomputation instead of in-memory state.

scope_options.name: Several polls coexisting in one directory
scope_options.rationale: The acceptance rule that different polls never mix implies more than one poll can exist; this slice adds poll selection or ids while keeping every option, ballot, and count scoped to its poll.

scope_options.name: Optional result visibility setting
scope_options.rationale: Maps upstream's always/closed/never result visibility onto this product as an optional host setting; without it members see the live tally, which is the scenario default.

scope_options.name: Voter code confirmation to reduce collisions
scope_options.rationale: Because a code is the ballot key, two members choosing the same code would overwrite each other; an optional confirmation or code-list check makes that collision visible without changing the one-ballot rule.

surfaces.name: Poll setup form
surfaces.purpose: Let the host pose the dinner question and enter the fixed option set before any vote is cast.

query.bulk: Not applicable: creation is a single atomic submit, not a bulk operation over records.
query.export: Not applicable: setup data is not exported; export is outside the product boundary.
query.filter: Not applicable: there is no list of polls on this surface to filter.
query.pagination: Not applicable: at most 8 option rows are shown, so all fit without paging.
query.search: Not applicable: the form edits a single poll in place, so no search is provided.
query.sort: Not applicable: option order is the order the host enters, not a sort control.

sections: Option list editor with 2-8 label rows
Inline validation messages for option count, blanks, and duplicates

states.empty: With no poll yet in the directory, the setup form is the entry point and shows two empty option rows.
states.error: A rejected submission keeps all entered text and shows the validation reason next to the offending field.
states.forbidden: The form is only offered to the host role; a member-facing entry shows a not_host notice and a link back to voting.
states.loading: The form appears with one empty question and two empty option rows while no store read is pending.
states.no_results: Not applicable: the form creates data rather than listing it, so there is no result set to be empty.

surfaces.name: Member voting surface
surfaces.purpose: Show the question and options, accept one pseudonymous choice, permit a replacement by the same code, and show the current aggregate.

query.bulk: Not applicable: a member submits exactly one ballot per action.
query.export: Not applicable: this surface does not export; results may be read on screen only.
query.filter: Not applicable: all options of the poll are always shown, including zero-count ones.
query.pagination: Not applicable: the bounded option set fits on one screen.
query.search: Not applicable: the option set is at most 8 entries and fully visible, so no search is offered.
query.sort: Options are shown in the host-defined position order; no member sort control exists.

sections: Option list with one selectable choice
Tie notice when the top count is shared

states.empty: A poll with no ballots yet lists every option with count 0 and total 0.
states.error: A rejected write shows its reason (poll_closed, option_not_in_poll, code_required, duplicate_code) while keeping the selected option and code for correction.
states.forbidden: A closed poll shows a closed notice in place of the submit control and offers no write action until the host reopens.
states.loading: The option list and tally show a loading indicator while the local store is read.
states.no_results: Not applicable: options always exist for an open poll, so the tally has at least zero-count rows to show.

surfaces.name: Host console
surfaces.purpose: Show poll status and aggregate, and expose the close and reopen transitions with their recorded events.

query.bulk: Not applicable: close and reopen are single targeted transitions.
query.export: Not applicable: exporting the aggregate is outside this product's boundary.
query.filter: Not applicable: there is no event or ballot list to filter; the event log is short and complete.
query.pagination: Not applicable: the event log is bounded by close/reopen activity on one poll.
query.search: Not applicable: the console controls one poll rather than browsing many.
query.sort: Events are shown newest last in recorded order; no sort control is provided.

sections: Status indicator with closed_at or open state

states.empty: A newly created poll shows no ballots, all counts 0, and only a created event.
states.error: A rejected transition (already_closed, already_open) is shown inline and the displayed status is re-read from the store.
states.forbidden: A member opening this surface sees a not_host notice and cannot invoke close or reopen.
states.loading: Status, counts, and event log are marked loading while the store is read.
states.no_results: Not applicable: the console always shows the poll's status and counts, never an empty result set.

surfaces.name: Result view
surfaces.purpose: Present the per-option tally and total as the poll's deliverable, including an explicit tie statement.

query.bulk: Not applicable: the view is read-only.
query.export: Not applicable: results are shared by reading the screen, not by export.
query.filter: Not applicable: zero-count options are intentionally retained rather than filtered out.
query.pagination: Not applicable: the option count is capped at 8.
query.search: Not applicable: one poll's options are all shown.
query.sort: Rows follow the host-defined option position order; no result sorting is offered.

sections: Tie statement listing all tied options when applicable
Poll status and freshness of the aggregate

states.empty: With no ballots the view lists every option at 0 and total 0 without declaring a winner.
states.error: An unreadable store produces an explicit error state rather than a blank or partial tally.
states.forbidden: Not applicable: both roles may read the aggregate; no role is denied this view in this product.
states.loading: Counts are marked loading until ballots are read and recomputed.
states.no_results: Not applicable: options always exist, so the aggregate always has rows even at zero.

schema_contract:
Exact root keys: schema, product_shape, roles, objects, actions, surfaces,
journeys, rules, assertions, scope_options, basis, gaps; schema is atlas.product-reference.v1.
product_shape={name,audience,value,delivery_profile,boundary,excluded}. roles rows
{id,name,goal,data_scope}; objects {id,name,fields:[{name,meaning}],states,relations:[{object_id,meaning}]};
actions {id,name,role_ids,object_ids,surface_ids,rule_ids,preconditions,effects,
failures:[{condition,response,recovery}],transitions:[{object_id,from_states,to_state}],basis_ids,depends_on};
surfaces {id,name,kind,purpose,role_ids,action_ids,sections,navigation,states:{loading,empty,no_results,error,forbidden},
query:{search,filter,sort,pagination,bulk,export}}; journeys {id,name,goal,role_ids,
steps:[{surface_id,action_id,role_id,success}],completion,recovery}; rules
{id,statement,object_ids,basis_ids}; assertions {id,given,when,then,negative,action_ids,rule_ids,journey_ids};
scope_options {id,name,journey_ids,extra_action_ids,depends_on,rationale}; basis
{id,kind,statement,source_ids,depends_on}, kind in requirement/upstream_observation/
design_inference/unknown; gaps {id,statement,core,action_ids,resolution}. IDs are
lowercase letters/digits/underscore/hyphen. Every action is asserted and has an
entry surface/object; every surface/action relation is symmetric. Only fixed trusted
IDs may appear in basis source_ids. Unknown core gaps block a complete reference.
Types: every scalar name/goal/meaning/statement/condition/response/recovery and
assertion given/when/then/negative is a NONBLANK STRING (negative describes the
negative expectation; it is not a boolean). product_shape audience/value/
delivery_profile/boundary are strings. surfaces states and query values are
nonblank explanatory strings, including an explicit reason when not applicable.
All *_ids, depends_on, sections, navigation, preconditions, effects, excluded,
from_states, object states, and source_ids are lists of strings. surface.states
and surface.query are exact-key maps of explanatory strings. gaps.core is the only boolean in the
reference schema. All IDs are globally unique across collections. Action failures,
preconditions and effects must be nonempty. A design_inference basis must depend_on
at least one known basis ID. Scope options select entire journeys plus dependency
closure, and need assertions whose action_ids and journey_ids are entirely within
that option; these assertions must cover all selected actions, rules and journeys.
Do not attach every unrelated journey to one assertion: reference the specific
journeys that the given/when/then actually tests. This is schema guidance, not an
instruction to limit product capability or weaken the confirmed scenario.
For UI products, separate preparation/input actions from submit/commit actions
when they have different effects or recovery. Model entry and navigation as
surfaces where appropriate. Keep assertions independently testable and avoid
duplicating unrelated journeys in one assertion or scope slice.
Enums are exact: surfaces.kind is web/desktop/cli/api/library/other; basis.kind is
requirement/upstream_observation/design_inference/unknown. Every object relation
must name an existing object. Every action has nonempty role_ids, object_ids,
surface_ids, basis_ids, preconditions, effects, and failures; action surface links
are symmetric and each action has an assertion. Transitions must name an action
object and states declared by that object. Every surface action link is symmetric,
all navigation IDs name surfaces, and at least one role can use each action surface.
Journey steps must agree with the journey, action, and surface role sets. Every
assertion rule must be used by one asserted action; every rule has an assertion.
Basis dependencies and action/scope dependencies are acyclic. Upstream basis
source_ids must be trusted and must have host-pinned observation evidence. Core
gaps block completion. Diagnostics are additive: fix each reported issue while
preserving all confirmed business behavior and all other valid graph content.

# Free meeting schedule tool
- :next_track_button: Easy poll creation
- :hammer_and_wrench: Highly customizable
    - :envelope: Make your poll confidential by hiding the results until you want them to be discovered
    - :dark_sunglasses: Obfuscate participants' names from other participants or set strong anonymous mode
    - :timer_clock: Set an automatic expiry date
    - :heavy_plus_sign: Allow participants to add more options
    - :white_check_mark: Limit votes per option or user
    - ... :currency_exchange: and a lot more
- :mailbox_with_mail: Invite everyone you want
- :rocket: Export your poll to different spreadsheet formats or HTML
- :red_envelope: Let Polls automatically remind your invited users
- :speech_balloon: Comments
- :ballot_box_with_check: Confirm options after poll closing
- :loudspeaker: Subscribe to notifications per poll
- :date: Get hints about possible conflicting entries in your calendar around the date option
- :toolbox: Usable via REST-API
- Supports the following nextcloud apps
    - Circles
    - Contacts
    - Activity

Find Polls in the [Nextcloud app store](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/polls).

## Commercial break and thank you
Thank you guys, who support this app over the years by reporting issues, ideas and even helping analyzing difficult situations. This app can only be maintained with your help and with your proven patience. This is the biggest value the app could get over the last years since I took over the maintenance of Polls.

Out of reasons, I am adding another way to support me directly by [spending me a :coffee:](https://buymeacoffee.com/dartcafe). But please, only do that if you can really afford it and have an advantage by using this app.

:notes: Commercial jingle fading off :musical_note:

- Report a bug or request a feature:  https://github.com/nextcloud/polls/issues
- Community support: https://help.nextcloud.com/c/apps/polls/

 * @method int getCurrentUserVotesMaybe()

 */

class Poll extends EntityWithUser implements JsonSerializable {
	public const TABLE = 'polls_polls';
	public const TYPE_DATE = 'datePoll';
	public const TYPE_TEXT = 'textPoll';
	public const VARIANT_SIMPLE = 'simple';
	public const ACCESS_PRIVATE = 'private';
	public const ACCESS_OPEN = 'open';
	public const SHOW_RESULTS_ALWAYS = 'always';
	public const SHOW_RESULTS_CLOSED = 'closed';
	public const SHOW_RESULTS_NEVER = 'never';
	public const PROPOSAL_DISALLOW = 'disallow';
	public const PROPOSAL_ALLOW = 'allow';
	public const PROPOSAL_REVIEW = 'review';
	public const URI_PREFIX = 'poll/';
	public const FIVE_DAYS = 432000;
	public const FOUR_DAYS = 345600;
	public const THREE_DAYS = 259200;
	public const TWO_DAYS = 172800;
	public const ONE_AND_HALF_DAY = 129600;

	public const ROLE_USER = Share::TYPE_USER;
	public const ROLE_ADMIN = Share::TYPE_ADMIN;
	public const ROLE_EMAIL = Share::TYPE_EMAIL;
	public const ROLE_CONTACT = Share::TYPE_CONTACT;
	public const ROLE_EXTERNAL = Share::TYPE_EXTERNAL;
	public const ROLE_OWNER = 'owner';
	public const ROLE_NONE = 'none';

	public const PERMISSION_OVERRIDE = 'override_permission';
	public const PERMISSION_POLL_ACCESS = 'accessPoll';
	public const PERMISSION_POLL_ARCHIVE = 'archivePoll';
	public const PERMISSION_POLL_CHANGE_OWNER = 'changePollOwner';
	public const PERMISSION_POLL_DELETE = 'deletePoll';
	public const PERMISSION_POLL_DOWNLOAD = 'downloadPoll';
	public const PERMISSION_POLL_EDIT = 'editPoll';
	public const PERMISSION_POLL_RESULTS_VIEW = 'seePollResults';
	public const PERMISSION_POLL_SUBSCRIBE = 'subscribePoll';
	public const PERMISSION_POLL_TAKEOVER = 'takeOverPoll';
	public const PERMISSION_POLL_USERNAMES_VIEW = 'seeUserNames';
	public const PERMISSION_COMMENT_ADD = 'addComment';
	public const PERMISSION_COMMENT_DELETE = 'deleteComment';
	public const PERMISSION_OPTION_ADD = 'addOptions';
	public const PERMISSION_OPTION_CONFIRM = 'confirmOption';
	public const PERMISSION_OPTION_CLONE = 'cloneOption';
	public const PERMISSION_OPTION_DELETE = 'deleteOption';
	public const PERMISSION_OPTIONS_REORDER = 'reorderOptions';
	public const PERMISSION_VOTE_EDIT = 'vote';
	public const PERMISSION_VOTE_FOREIGN_CHANGE = 'changeForeignVotes';
	public const PERMISSION_SHARE_ADD = 'shareCreate';
	public const PERMISSION_SHARE_ADD_EXTERNAL = 'shareCreateExternal';
	public const PERMISSION_DEANONYMIZE = 'deanonymize';

	private IURLGenerator $urlGenerator;
	protected SystemSettings $systemSettings;
	protected AppSettings $appSettings;
	protected UserSession $userSession;

	// schema columns
	public $id = null;
	protected string $type = '';
	protected string $title = '';
	protected ?string $description = '';
	protected ?string $owner = '';
	protected int $created = 0;
	protected int $expire = 0;
	protected int $deleted = 0;
	protected string $access = '';
	protected int $anonymous = 0;
	protected int $allowMaybe = 0;
	protected string $allowProposals = '';
	protected int $proposalsExpire = 0;
	protected int $voteLimit = 0;
	protected int $optionLimit = 0;
	protected string $showResults = '';
	protected int $adminAccess = 0;
	protected int $allowComment = 0;
	protected int $hideBookedUp = 0;
	protected int $useNo = 1;
	protected int $lastInteraction = 0;
	protected ?string $miscSettings = '';
	protected string $votingVariant = '';
	protected ?string $timezoneName = null;

	// joined columns
	protected ?int $isCurrentUserLocked = 0;
	protected string $userRole = self::ROLE_NONE;
	protected string $shareToken = '';
	protected ?string $groupShares = '';
	protected ?string $pollGroups = '';
	protected ?string $pollGroupUserShares = '';
	protected int $currentUserVotes = 0;
	protected int $currentUserVotesYes = 0;
	protected int $currentUserVotesNo = 0;
	protected int $currentUserVotesMaybe = 0;
	protected int $participantsCount = 0;
	protected int $currentUserOrphanedVotes = 0;
	protected ?int $maxDate = 0;

	public function __construct() {
		$this->addType('created', 'integer');
		$this->addType('expire', 'integer');
		$this->addType('deleted', 'integer');
		$this->addType('anonymous', 'integer');
		$this->addType('allowComment', 'integer');
		$this->addType('allowMaybe', 'integer');
		$this->addType('proposalsExpire', 'integer');
		$this->addType('voteLimit', 'integer');
		$this->addType('optionLimit', 'integer');
		$this->addType('adminAccess', 'integer');
		$this->addType('hideBookedUp', 'integer');
		$this->addType('useNo', 'integer');
		$this->addType('lastInteraction', 'integer');

		// joined columns
		$this->addType('isCurrentUserLocked', 'integer');
		$this->addType('maxDate', 'integer');
		$this->addType('currentUserVotes', 'integer');
		$this->addType('currentUserVotesYes', 'integer');
		$this->addType('currentUserVotesNo', 'integer');
		$this->addType('currentUserVotesMaybe', 'integer');
		$this->addType('currentUserOrphanedVotes', 'integer');
		$this->addType('participantsCount', 'integer');

		$this->urlGenerator = Container::queryClass(IURLGenerator::class);
		$this->systemSettings = Container::queryClass(SystemSettings::class);
		$this->appSettings = Container::queryClass(AppSettings::class);
		$this->userSession = Container::queryClass(UserSession::class);
	}

	public function __clone() {
		$this->setId(0);
		$this->setTitle('Clone of ' . $this->getTitle());
		$this->setDeleted(0);
		$this->setCreated(time());
		$this->setAccess(self::ACCESS_PRIVATE);
		// deanonymize cloned polls by default, to avoid locked anonymous polls
		$this->setAnonymous(0);
	}

	/**
	 * Build a fresh Poll entity pre-populated from this poll's settings.
	 * The fresh entity's id is never set, so QBMapper::insert() relies on the
	 * DB autoincrement to assign a fresh id.
	 */
	public function createClone(string $newOwner): self {
		$clone = new self();
		$clone->setType($this->getType());
		$clone->setVotingVariant($this->getVotingVariant());
		$clone->setTitle('Clone of ' . $this->getTitle());
		$clone->setDescription($this->getDescription());
		$clone->setOwner($newOwner);
		$clone->setCreated(time());
		$clone->setLastInteraction(0);
		$clone->setExpire($this->getExpire());
		$clone->setDeleted(0);
		$clone->setAccess(self::ACCESS_PRIVATE);
		$clone->setAnonymous(0);
		$clone->setAllowComment($this->getAllowComment());
		$clone->setAllowMaybe($this->getAllowMaybe());
		$clone->setAllowProposals($this->getAllowProposals());
		$clone->setProposalsExpire($this->getProposalsExpire());
		$clone->setVoteLimit($this->getVoteLimit());
		$clone->setOptionLimit($this->getOptionLimit());
		$clone->setShowResults($this->getShowResults());
		$clone->setAdminAccess($this->getAdminAccess());
		$clone->setHideBookedUp($this->getHideBookedUp());
		$clone->setUseNo($this->getUseNo());
		$clone->setMiscSettings($this->getMiscSettings());
		$clone->setTimezoneName($this->getTimezoneName());
		return $clone;
	}

	 * @return array
	 *
	 * @psalm-suppress PossiblyUnusedMethod
	 */
	/** @return PollsPoll */
	public function jsonSerialize(): array {
		return [
			'id' => $this->getId(),
			'type' => $this->getType(),
			'votingVariant' => $this->getVotingVariant(),
			'configuration' => $this->getConfigurationArray(),
			'descriptionSafe' => $this->getDescriptionSafe(),
			'owner' => $this->getUser()->jsonSerialize(),
			'status' => $this->getStatusArray(),
			'currentUserStatus' => $this->getCurrentUserStatus(),
			'permissions' => $this->getPermissionsArray(),
			'pollGroups' => $this->getPollGroups(),
		];
	}

	/** @return PollsPollsStatus */
	public function getStatusArray(): array {
		return [
			'lastInteraction' => $this->getLastInteraction(),
			'created' => $this->getCreated(),
			'isAnonymous' => boolval($this->getAnonymous()),
			'isArchived' => boolval($this->getDeleted()),
			'isExpired' => $this->getIsExpired(),
			'isRealAnonymous' => $this->getAnonymous() < 0,
			'relevantThreshold' => $this->getRelevantThreshold(),
			'deletionDate' => $this->getDeletionDate(),
			'archivedDate' => $this->getDeleted(),
			'countParticipants' => $this->getIsAllowed(self::PERMISSION_POLL_RESULTS_VIEW) ? $this->getParticipantsCount() : 0,
			'maxVotes' => $this->getVoteLimit(),
			'maxOptionVotes' => $this->getOptionLimit(),
			'forcedViewMode' => $this->getForcedDisplayMode() === 'user-pref' ? null : $this->getForcedDisplayMode(),
		];
	}
	/** @return PollsPollConfiguration */
	public function getConfigurationArray(): array {
		return [
			'access' => $this->getAccess(),
			'allowComment' => boolval($this->getAllowComment()),
			'allowMaybe' => boolval($this->getAllowMaybe()),
			'allowProposals' => $this->getAllowProposals(),
			'anonymous' => boolval($this->getAnonymous()),
			'autoReminder' => $this->getAutoReminder(),
			'collapseDescription' => $this->getCollapseDescription(),
			'description' => $this->getDescription(),
			'allowDownload' => $this->getAllowDownload(),
			'expire' => $this->getExpire(),
			'forceConfidentialComments' => $this->getForceConfidentialComments(),
			'forcedDisplayMode' => $this->getForcedDisplayMode(),

	public function getUserRole(): string {
		if ($this->getCurrentUserIsEntityUser()) {
			return self::ROLE_OWNER;
		}

		$evaluatedRole = $this->userRole;

		// If user is not a poll admin (set by normal poll share) and poll group shares exist,
		// iterate over the share types and return the higher role
		if ($this->getPollGroupUserShares() && !$evaluatedRole) {
			// return the higher role of the group shares
			foreach ($this->getPollGroupUserShares() as $shareType) {
				if ($shareType === self::ROLE_ADMIN) {
					$evaluatedRole = self::ROLE_ADMIN;
				}
				return self::ROLE_USER;
			}
		}

		if ($this->getIsCurrentUserLocked() && $this->userRole === self::ROLE_ADMIN) {
			return self::ROLE_USER;
		}

		if ($this->userSession->getShareType() === Share::TYPE_PUBLIC) {
			return Share::TYPE_PUBLIC;
		}

		return $evaluatedRole;
	}

		// if anonymous is locked, do not allow changes
		if ($this->getAnonymous() < 0) {

		if (!$this->getAllowDeanonymize() && $value > 0) {

			$value = -1;

	/**

	 * @throws ForbiddenException Thrown if access is denied
	 */
	public function request(string $permission): Poll {
		if (!$this->getIsAllowed($permission)) {
			throw new ForbiddenException('denied permission ' . $permission);
		}
		return $this;
	}

	/**
	 * Check particular rights and inform via boolean value, if the right is granted or denied
	 */
	public function getIsAllowed(string $permission): bool {
		return match ($permission) {
			self::PERMISSION_COMMENT_ADD => $this->getAllowCommenting(),
			self::PERMISSION_COMMENT_DELETE => $this->getAllowDeleteComment(),
			self::PERMISSION_OPTION_ADD => $this->getAllowAddOptions(),
			self::PERMISSION_OPTION_CONFIRM => $this->getAllowConfirmOption(),
			self::PERMISSION_OPTION_CLONE => $this->getAllowCloneOption(),
			self::PERMISSION_OPTION_DELETE => $this->getAllowDeleteOption(),
			self::PERMISSION_OPTIONS_REORDER => $this->getAllowReorderOptions(),
			self::PERMISSION_OVERRIDE => true,
			self::PERMISSION_POLL_ACCESS => $this->getAllowAccessPoll(),
			self::PERMISSION_POLL_EDIT => $this->getAllowEditPoll(),
			self::PERMISSION_POLL_DELETE => $this->getAllowDeletePoll(),
			self::PERMISSION_POLL_ARCHIVE => $this->getAllowEditPoll(),
			self::PERMISSION_POLL_TAKEOVER => $this->getAllowTakeOver(),
			self::PERMISSION_POLL_CHANGE_OWNER => $this->getAllowChangeOwner(),
			self::PERMISSION_POLL_SUBSCRIBE => $this->getAllowSubscribeToPoll(),
			self::PERMISSION_POLL_RESULTS_VIEW => $this->getAllowShowResults(),
			self::PERMISSION_POLL_USERNAMES_VIEW => $this->getAllowEditPoll() || !$this->getAnonymous(),
			self::PERMISSION_VOTE_EDIT => $this->getAllowVote(),
			self::PERMISSION_VOTE_FOREIGN_CHANGE => $this->getAllowChangeForeignVotes(),
			self::PERMISSION_SHARE_ADD => $this->systemSettings->getShareCreateAllowed(),
			self::PERMISSION_SHARE_ADD_EXTERNAL => $this->systemSettings->getExternalShareCreationAllowed(),
			self::PERMISSION_DEANONYMIZE => $this->getAllowDeanonymize(),
			self::PERMISSION_POLL_DOWNLOAD => $this->appSettings->getPollDownloadAllowed() && $this->getAllowDownload(),
			default => false,
		};
	}

	/**

	 * @return bool Returns true, if the current user is involved in the poll

	public function getIsInvolved(): bool {
		return (

			|| $this->getIsParticipant()
			|| $this->getIsPersonallyInvited())
			|| $this->getIsInvitedViaGroupShare();
	}

	/**
	 * Check, if poll settings is set to open access for internal users
	 */
	private function getIsOpenPoll(): bool {
		return $this->getAccess() === Poll::ACCESS_OPEN && $this->userSession->getIsLoggedIn();
	}

	/**
	 * getIsParticipant - Is user a participant?
	 * @return bool Returns true, if the current user is already a particitipant of the current poll.

	private function getIsParticipant(): bool {

	}

	/**
	 * getIsInvitedViaGroupShare - Is the poll shared via group share?
	 * where the current user is member of. This only affects logged in users.
	 * @return bool Returns true, if the current poll contains a group share with a group,
	 */
	private function getIsInvitedViaGroupShare(): bool {
		if (!$this->userSession->getIsLoggedIn()) {
			return false;
		}

		return count($this->getGroupSharesForUser()) > 0;
	}

	private function getGroupSharesForUser(): array {
		return array_filter($this->getGroupShares(), function ($groupName) {

		});
	}
	/**
	 * getIsPersonallyInvited - Is the poll shared via user share with the current user?
	 * Checking via user role
	 * @return bool Returns true, if the current poll contains a user role which matches a share type

	private function getIsPersonallyInvited(): bool {
		return in_array($this->getUserRole(), [
			Poll::ROLE_ADMIN,
			Poll::ROLE_USER,
			Poll::ROLE_EXTERNAL,
			Poll::ROLE_EMAIL,
			Poll::ROLE_CONTACT,

	/**
	 * The detailed checks - For the sake of readability, the queries and selections
	 * were kept detailed and with low complexity
	 */

	/**
	 * Checks, if the user has delegated admin rights to edit poll settings via share
	 */
	private function getIsDelegatedAdmin(): bool {
		return $this->getUserRole() === Poll::ROLE_ADMIN
			&& !$this->getIsCurrentUserLocked();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if user is allowed to edit the poll configuration
	 **/
	private function getAllowEditPoll(): bool {
		// Console has god mode
		if (defined('OC_CONSOLE')) {
			return true;
		}

		// owner is always allowed to edit the poll configuration
		if ($this->getIsPollOwner()) {
			return true;
		}

		// user has delegated owner rights
		if ($this->getIsDelegatedAdmin()) {
			return true;
		}

		// deny edit rights in all other cases
		return false;
	}

	private function getAllowTakeOver(): bool {
		return $this->userSession->getCurrentUser()->getIsAdmin();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if user is allowed to edit the poll configuration
	 **/
	private function getAllowChangeOwner(): bool {
		return $this->getAllowEditPoll()
		|| $this->userSession->getCurrentUser()->getIsAdmin();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if user is allowed to access (view) poll
	 */
	private function getAllowAccessPoll(): bool {
		// edit rights include access to poll
		if ($this->getAllowEditPoll()) {
			return true;
		}

		// No further access to poll, if it is deleted
		if ($this->getDeleted()) {
			return false;
		}

		// grant access if poll poll is an open poll (for logged in users)
		if ($this->getIsOpenPoll() && $this->userSession->getIsLoggedIn()) {
			return true;
		}

		// grant access if user is involved in poll in any way
		if ($this->getIsInvolved()) {
			return true;
		}

		$share = $this->userSession->getShare();
		// return check result of an existing valid share for this user
		return boolval($share->getId() && $share->getPollId() === $this->getId());
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if user is allowed to delete the poll
	 * includes the right to archive and take over
	 **/
	private function getAllowDeletePoll(): bool {
		if ($this->getAllowEditPoll()) {
			// users with edit rights are allowed to delete the poll
			return true;
		}

		// additionally site admins are allowed to delete polls, in all other cases deny poll deletion right
		return $this->userSession->getCurrentUser()->getIsAdmin();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if user is allowed to add add vote options
	 **/
	private function getAllowAddOptions(): bool {
		// Edit right includes adding new options
		if ($this->getAllowEditPoll()) {
			return true;
		}

		// deny, if user has no access right to this poll
		if (!$this->getAllowAccessPoll()) {
			return false;
		}

		// deny, if user is not allowed to vote
		if (!$this->getAllowVote()) {
			return false;
		}

		// public shares are not allowed to add options
		if ($this->userSession->getShare()->getType() === Share::TYPE_PUBLIC) {
			return false;
		}

		// Request for option proposals is expired, deny
		if ($this->getProposalPeriodIsExpired()) {
			return false;
		}

		// Locked Users are not allowed to add options
		if (boolval($this->getIsCurrentUserLocked())) {
			return false;
		}

		// Allow, if poll requests proposals
		return $this->getAllowProposals() === Poll::PROPOSAL_ALLOW;
	}

	private function getAllowCloneOption(): bool {
		return $this->getAllowEditPoll();
	}

	/**
	 * Is current user allowed to delete options from poll
	 */
	private function getAllowDeleteOption(): bool {
		return $this->getIsPollOwner() || $this->getIsDelegatedAdmin();
	}

	/**
	 * Is current user allowed to confirm options
	 */
	private function getAllowConfirmOption(): bool {
		return $this->getAllowEditPoll() && $this->getIsExpired();
	}

	/**
	 * Is current user allowed to confirm options
	 */
	private function getAllowReorderOptions(): bool {
		return $this->getAllowEditPoll() && !$this->getIsExpired() && $this->getType() === Poll::TYPE_TEXT;
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if the current user is the poll owner
	 **/
	public function getIsPollOwner(): bool {
		return ($this->getUserRole() === Poll::ROLE_OWNER);
	}

	/**
	 * Permission checks
	 */

	/**
	 * Checks, if user is allowed to see and write comments
	 **/
	private function getAllowCommenting(): bool {
		if ($this->getAllowEditPoll()) {
			// users with edit rights are allowed to comment
			return true;
		}

		// user has no access right to this poll
		if (!$this->getAllowAccessPoll()) {
			return false;
		}

		// public shares are not allowed to comment
		if ($this->userSession->getShare()->getType() === Share::TYPE_PUBLIC) {
			return false;
		}

		// public shares are not allowed to comment
		if (boolval($this->getIsCurrentUserLocked())) {
			return false;
		}

		// return the poll setting for comments
		return (bool)$this->getAllowComment();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if user is allowed to delete comments from poll
	 **/
	private function getAllowDeleteComment(): bool {
		return $this->getAllowEditPoll();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if poll owner is allowed to change votes
	 **/
	private function getAllowChangeForeignVotes(): bool {
		return $this->getAnonymous() > -1 && $this->getAllowEditPoll() && $this->getUser()->getIsUnrestrictedPollOwner();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if poll owner is allowed to deanonymize votes
	 **/
	private function getAllowDeanonymize(): bool {
		// Deanonymization is only allowed,
		// if the anonymize setting is not locked
		// and the current user is allowed to edit the poll
		// and the owner of the poll is unrestricted
		return $this->getAnonymous() > -1
			&& $this->getAllowEditPoll()
			&& $this->getUser()->getIsUnrestrictedPollOwner();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if user is allowed to vote
	 **/
	private function getAllowVote(): bool {
		// user has no access right to this poll
		if (!$this->getAllowAccessPoll()) {
			return false;
		}

		// Only external, user or admin shares are allowed to vote
		// All other external types have to register first
		if (!in_array($this->userSession->getCurrentUser()->getType(), [UserBase::TYPE_EXTERNAL, UserBase::TYPE_USER, UserBase::TYPE_ADMIN])) {
			return false;
		}

		// Locked users are not allowed to vote
		if (boolval($this->getIsCurrentUserLocked())) {
			return false;
		}

		// deny votes, if poll is expired
		return !$this->getIsExpired();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if user is allowed to subscribe to updates
	 **/
	private function getAllowSubscribeToPoll(): bool {
		// user with access to poll are always allowed to subscribe
		if (!$this->getAllowAccessPoll()) {
			return false;
		}

		return $this->userSession->getCurrentUser()->getHasEmail();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks, if user is allowed to see results of current poll
	 **/
	private function getAllowShowResults(): bool {
		// edit rights include access to results
		if ($this->getAllowEditPoll()) {
			return true;
		}

		// no access to poll, deny
		if (!$this->getAllowAccessPoll()) {
			return false;
		}

		// show results, when poll is closed
		if ($this->getShowResults() === Poll::SHOW_RESULTS_CLOSED && $this->getIsExpired()) {
			return true;
		}
		// return poll settings
		return $this->getShowResults() === Poll::SHOW_RESULTS_ALWAYS;

namespace OCA\Polls\Db;

use JsonSerializable;
use OCA\Polls\Helper\Hash;

/**
 * @psalm-suppress UnusedProperty
 * @psalm-import-type PollsVote from \OCA\Polls\ResponseDefinitions
 * @method int getId()
 * @method void setId(int $value)
 * @method int getPollId()
 * @method void setPollId(int $value)
 * @method string getUserId()
 * @method void setUserId(string $value)
 * @method int getVoteOptionId()
 * @method void setVoteOptionId(int $value)
 * @method string getVoteOptionText()
 * @method void setVoteOptionText(string $value)
 * @method string getVoteOptionHash()
 * @method void setVoteOptionHash(string $value)
 * @method string getVoteAnswer()
 * @method void setVoteAnswer(string $value)
 * @method int getDeleted()
 * @method void setDeleted(int $value)
 *
 * Joined Attributes
 * @method ?int getOptionId()
 */
class Vote extends EntityWithUser implements JsonSerializable {
	public const TABLE = 'polls_votes';
	public const VOTE_YES = 'yes';
	public const VOTE_NO = 'no';
	public const VOTE_EVENTUALLY = 'maybe';

	// schema columns
	public $id = null;
	protected int $pollId = 0;
	protected string $userId = '';
	protected int $voteOptionId = 0;
	protected string $voteOptionText = '';
	protected string $voteOptionHash = '';
	protected string $voteAnswer = '';
	protected int $deleted = 0;

	// joined columns
	protected ?int $optionId = null;

	public function __construct(
	) {
		$this->addType('id', 'integer');
		$this->addType('pollId', 'integer');
		$this->addType('voteOptionId', 'integer');
		$this->addType('deleted', 'integer');
	}

	private function getAnswerSymbol(): string {
		switch ($this->getVoteAnswer()) {
			case self::VOTE_YES:
				return '✔';
			case self::VOTE_NO:
				return '❌';
			case self::VOTE_EVENTUALLY:
				return '❔';
			default:
				return '';
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Get the hash for the vote option. This is generated from the option text
	 * and poll id.
	 *
	 * @return string
	 *
	 * @psalm-suppress PossiblyUnusedMethod
	 */
	public function getVoteOptionHash(): string {
		return Hash::getOptionHash(
			$this->getPollId(),
			$this->getVoteOptionText(),
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the hash for the vote option as stored in the database. This is used
	 * to identify incorrect hashes stored in the db, because getVoteOptionHash()
	 * which is generated from the option text and poll id.
	 *
	 * @return string
	 *
	 * @psalm-suppress PossiblyUnusedMethod
	 */
	public function getVoteOptionHashInDb(): string {
		return $this->voteOptionHash;
	}

	/**
	 * @return array
	 *
	 * @psalm-suppress PossiblyUnusedMethod
	 */
	/** @return PollsVote */
	public function jsonSerialize(): array {
		return [
			'id' => $this->getId(),
			'pollId' => $this->getPollId(),
			'optionText' => $this->getVoteOptionText(),
			'answer' => $this->getVoteAnswer(),
			'deleted' => $this->getDeleted(),
			'optionId' => $this->getOptionId(),
			'user' => $this->getUser()->jsonSerialize(),
			'answerSymbol' => $this->getAnswerSymbol(),
		];
	}
}
